blockingFindings.title: Binding command drops explicit no-Issue guard
blockingFindings.issue: `FlowTargetBinding.guardCommand()` always emits only `--expect-binding`, even when the captured binding has `issue: null`. Existing guard semantics require a no-Issue target to be explicit so a later Issue-bearing active flow cannot be selected accidentally.
blockingFindings.suggestion: Update `FlowTargetBinding.guardCommand()` or the binding-consuming CLI boundary so commands produced from a no-Issue binding include or enforce the equivalent of `--expect-no-issue`; the affected branch is the `this.issue === null` binding case.
blockingFindings.rationale: R8 is a target identity requirement, and the touched spec test asserts that no-Issue identity remains explicit. As written, serialized command text does not expose that guard and risks weakening the mandatory target binding behavior.
